limitations: This is a documentation-only change; no runtime code path changed, so no live/DB or binary behavior is claimed.

No prose-content gate exists for these files (scripts/ci_taxonomy.py --check reads only docs/ci_taxonomy.json and the workflows; scripts/docs_generate.sh owns README.md, docs/configuration.md and oraclemcp.example.toml). The planted-negative analogue is therefore the git before/after grep, not a failing-then-passing gate.

The bead's synthetic UI fixture could not be aligned in lane because it is generated from Rust (crates/oraclemcp-core/src/operator_protocol.rs); editing the fixture alone breaks generated_operator_schema_artifacts_match_rust_contract.

A committed gate (crate_local_ci_taxonomy_matches_repo_root) is red at this commit because crates/oraclemcp-core/ci_taxonomy.json still carries tier=advisory; that file is outside the declared lane and is embedded in production code.

The cargo tests were not executed in this session: the shared checkout is dirty with other agents' crates/** edits (rule 13/14), so the crate-local equality failure is proven textually (diff) against the test's assert_eq! rather than by running it.
